description: This file contains test helpers and mock implementations related to cookie store management in the Chromium project, including classes for delayed cookie operations, cookie URL handling, persistent store simulation, and callback counting.

classes.name: DelayedCookieMonsterChangeDispatcher
classes.description: Mock dispatcher for cookie change subscriptions, with methods to add callbacks for cookie changes.

classes.name: DelayedCookieMonster
classes.description: Mock implementation of a cookie monster that delays operations and manages cookie operations asynchronously.

classes.name: CookieURLHelper
classes.description: Helper class for URL manipulation and formatting related to cookies.

classes.name: FlushablePersistentStore
classes.description: Simulated persistent store for cookies with load and flush capabilities.

classes.name: CallbackCounter
classes.description: Utility class to count callback invocations.

methods.name: GetRegistry
methods.description: Extracts the registry part of a URL based on domain and registry length.

methods.name: AppendPath
methods.description: Appends a path to the base URL.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Formats a string by replacing placeholders with domain and registry info.
